newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian death toll reaches 15 at 0930 gmt.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian death toll reaches 15 at 0930 gmt.

text.p: Fifteen Palestinians have been shot dead in clashes with Israeli soldiers over the last two days, Palestinian health officials said on Thursday.

Sources at Rafah clinic in the Gaza Strip said Mohammed Bayoumi, 14, was shot dead at Rafah, raising to seven the number of Palestinians killed in the Strip. Health officials in the West Bank said three were killed in clashes there. Five were killed on Wednesday.
